description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Upgrade the ZavaCurrencyService application to the latest .NET LTS framework.
tasks.reason: The user explicitly requested modernization to the latest framework and the current project is a legacy .NET Framework application.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade the project runtime and project format to the latest .NET LTS (net10.0) while preserving existing service behavior and endpoints.

tasks.description: Modernize application integrations to Azure cloud-native services.
tasks.reason: The user requested cloud-native service modernization as part of the plan execution goal.
tasks.requirements: Migrate data access, configuration, secrets, and identity usage to Azure cloud-native services, including Azure SQL Database, Azure App Configuration, Azure Key Vault, and Managed Identity.

tasks.description: Scan all project dependencies for known CVEs and remediate identified vulnerabilities.
tasks.reason: Security remediation is required in every modernization plan before deployment.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade vulnerable dependencies to patched versions, document major-version upgrade risks when required, and verify the project build and tests after remediation.

tasks.description: Deploy the modernized application to Azure.
tasks.reason: The user explicitly requested deployment of the modernized application to Azure.
tasks.requirements: Containerize as needed and deploy the modernized application to Azure Container Apps with production-ready configuration.
